name: Southeast Buenos Aires (Balcarce)
source: Asking prices of agricultural fields in Balcarce on real-estate portals (Zonaprop, Argenprop, Agrofy, brokers), October 2026: about USD 10,000–12,000/ha for agricultural land, USD 5,000–7,500/ha for mixed or livestock land. Asking prices, not transactions. Rent not checked.
